Super compact yet incredibly powerful. Designed for life on the move, this GaN charger combines 100W high-speed charging with four versatile ports, so you can fuel all your devices at once without compromise.

Unlock Power Delivery for Type-C laptops, tablets, phones, weather stations & more


Charge up to 4 devices at once with 3 USB-C ports & 1 USB-A port
